description: This file declares the DobbyInterface class, which provides an interface for managing container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, pause, resume, and querying container information. It also handles container annotations, mounting, and unmounting, and includes event callback methods. The class interacts with external components like DobbyProxy, IpcService, and OmiProxy, and references related interfaces and protocols.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class providing container management functionalities, event handling, and integrations with Dobby and OMI proxies for container lifecycle operations.
